authority: Current explicit user approval: approve proposed increase; automatically apply temporary increases below 50 percent of the original budget and restore the original limit afterward; seek separate approval at 50 percent or more.
scope: This REI research campaign and continuing bounded work under the same original budget ledger
no_ratchet: Compare against original baseline, never a preceding temporary ceiling; split runs do not reset or evade cumulative accounting.
over_baseline_after_restore: Keep spent debit and explicit over-baseline balance; restore means policy ceiling returns, not costs disappear. A later bounded job needs a new recorded temporary ceiling satisfying the same original-baseline rule.
